player_prompt.intro:
Iwe ndiwe Mutambo {player_id}. Uri kucheza Guess The Number.
Unofanira kudhonza nambari kati ya {min_number} na {max_number} mukati me {max_turns} zvikwata.
Wakati wa kupindura, mutambo uyu unokupa mazano anenge 'zvakwira' kana 'zvadzikira'.
Unogona kupindura nambari yako kana njira ipi. Nambari ndiyo chete inenge iri muma bracket zvinenge [5] ndiyo inenge ichitazwa kunge nambari yako.
Wakati wa kucheza, nyaya yezvikwata zvako zvinenge zvawedzerwa zasi. Shandisa mashoko aya kukunda mutambo kabla hazviperi zvikwata zvako.
Pindura nambari yako.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mhando yekutamba isingaite. Mutambi {player_id} haana kupindura ne '[number]' inotenderwa.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kutamba kusina kukodzera. Mutambi {player_id} akafungidzira nhamba iri kunze kwenzvimbo yakatarwa.
invalid_move.already_guessed: Kutamba kusina kukodzera. Mutambi {player_id} akatodudza nhamba yacho kare.

outcome.turn_limit: Mipaka ya mzunguko imewekwa. Dhani: {guess}, Lengo: {target}
